nova.semExcecoes: Every guest follows the house routine.
nova.semExcecoesDica: An exception is made in the shift routine, under Manage routine, or in the guest's record.

excecoes.texto: Guests with their own times, or without a house service, each with the reason. Changing the house routine does not touch them: the exception stays until it is undone in the guest's record.

blocos.texto: Kennel A, Kennel B, Cattery, Garden. Each card says the type, the size it takes, how many fit and which rate it charges. Click to edit.

parada.texto: A room under repair leaves the map and cannot be sold. The "how many days" is the information: down for two hours is maintenance; for three weeks, it is a forgotten room.
parada.titulo: Out of service, with a date

pergunta.texto: How the house is set up. The system does not guess how many kennels you have: the operation registers them, on the day the house changes.

tarifas.texto: The house is the aisles and the rooms. Rate cards cross card and size, and the second pet comes in as a percentage. Seasons recur: they apply every year on the same range of dates.

checkout.texto: Check-out will not close until every belonging is checked off and the animal is weighed again. It is the cheapest complaint to prevent and the dearest to fix.
checkout.titulo: What came in must go out

ficha.texto: What the owner agreed: food and times, medication, what came in the bag, what they authorised and who to call in an emergency.

ocorrencias.texto: Bad news does not go by app. A serious incident holds the owner's report until someone from the house calls, and the button to log that call is right there.

pergunta.texto: How this animal is doing. Everything about the stay in one place, and check-out happens here.

rotina.texto: Tasks come from the intake form: the food the owner sent, the medicine on time, the walk. You can tick them here without going back to the shift clipboard.

cartao.texto: The disc shows which service and takes on colour when it's due: peach if it's late, solid coral only when there's a serious incident the owner hasn't heard about. The number beside it counts how many are late.
cartao.titulo: The line that asks for action

linhas.texto: The calm ones become a thin list at the foot of the page, so the room goes to whoever needs you. Click the band title to open and close it.
linhas.titulo: Those who are fine stay folded away

pergunta.texto: How each animal in the house is doing. One card per guest, ordered by who needs you first.

recortes.texto: Everyone, those who need you, and those leaving today. The middle one is what you check mid-shift; the right one, late morning.

grade.texto: Each row is a room, each column a night. The bars are what is already sold, and the gap between them is where the next booking fits. Click an empty cell to book from that day.

legenda.texto: Who is in the house now, what is confirmed, what has no deposit yet, and what is out of service. The hatched bar is a room out of operation, and it cannot be sold.

pergunta.texto: Is there a room free for those dates? Everything here exists so you can answer that with the caller still on the line.

procura.texto: Species, size, the dates and how many animals. The same sentence the caller says, in the same order.

resposta.texto: How many rooms fit those dates. Green means yes; red means nothing is free.

colunas.texto: The same information as the timeline, as a list, with the badge for what blocks. Click any row to open the booking or the stay.

pergunta.texto: What happens today. This is the first screen of the day: open it in the morning and you know what comes first.

resumo.texto: How many are in, arriving and leaving, and how many matters are urgent, in a single sentence.

travas.texto: It opens the screen because it has a deadline: a pending call, a report held behind it, an animal arriving without a vaccine. Each item is a button that takes you where it gets solved.

trilho.texto: Arrivals above, departures below, and a mark on "now". A triangle beside a name means that arrival or departure is blocked.

checkin.texto: Check-in stays blocked while a document bars it. It is not a reminder: it is a rule, and no screen can go around it.
checkin.titulo: The button only lights when allowed

exigencias.texto: Validity is checked against the last day of the stay, not against today. Red blocks entry; amber warns it expires mid-stay and there is still time to renew.

pergunta.texto: What it costs, and whether this animal may come in. This is the stay contract, and check-in starts here.

periodo.texto: In, out, how many nights and in which room. If the planned departure is past the house time, the half-night is already on the quote, not a surprise at the desk.

espera.texto: The waiting list sits at the bottom because it is only read when a booking falls through, and by then you are already on this screen.

horizonte.texto: The screen opens on what is ahead, which is the everyday question. History has not gone: it is in the other option, for when you need last month's stay.

pergunta.texto: What is sold, and what will cause trouble. This is the day-before screen: open it late afternoon to see what to sort out before tomorrow.

tabela.texto: Paperwork is sortable: one click on the header brings everything that will block at the desk to the top. That is how you sweep the week.

vespera.texto: Who arrives within three days and still cannot check in for missing paperwork. Three days because that is how long the owner still has to bring it.

cartoes.texto: Revenue by booking source and by service, the period's incidents, and the losses. A cancellation is notice, you could resell; a no-show is a burnt room.
cartoes.titulo: Where it comes from, and what is lost

grafico.texto: Drawn day by day, not as an average: the average hides exactly what you want to see, which is the house filling on the weekend and emptying on Tuesday.

numeros.texto: Average occupancy, revenue, average nightly rate and returning rate. Returning counts owners who had come before: it is loyalty, not volume.

pergunta.texto: Was the month worth it. This is the only screen that looks back, and it is for deciding, not for operating.

periodo.texto: It opens on the last thirty days. Every number and every card on this screen answers for the period chosen here, and no other.

filtros.texto: Meal, medication, walk, cleaning, water. Whoever is feeding everyone at once filters by meal and works down the list.
filtros.titulo: One kind of task at a time

marcar.texto: Done, refused or skip, right on the row. "Refused" is not a typo: it is clinical information, and four refused meals in a row become an incident.

passagem.texto: At the foot of the clipboard: how many tasks stay for the next shift and what blocks handover. It shows from the start of the shift, not just at handover time — an incident without contact at 10pm can no longer be fixed.

pergunta.texto: What to do right now. This is the shift clipboard: keep it open on your phone while you work the kennel.

progresso.texto: How many of today's tasks are already ticked, out of the total. It tells you whether the shift is on track without counting rows.

ronda.texto: Tasks of the same service at the same hour become a round — "Meal, 20 animals". Short rounds open by default; long ones open with a tap. A whole round can be marked at once, except medication: that one is marked animal by animal.

tempo.texto: Tasks group into rounds, and each round leads with its time. Anything overdue moves up to "For now", with the time in red — it never gets lost mid-list.
tempo.titulo: Now, later, and what has passed

limite.texto: Meals and medication do not appear: their times come from each guest record. The hotel does not prescribe, and no setup screen can create or change a dose.

pergunta.texto: What the house does for every guest, and at what times. It is the baseline each animal routine inherits.

publicar.texto: Before saving, the screen shows how many tasks are created, removed and left untouched. Anything already done is never touched, and starting tomorrow leaves the current shift alone.
publicar.titulo: Publishing says what it will do first

regua.texto: Each band is a house service, with its times marked across 24 hours. From a distance you can see whether the day is well spread or everything lands in the morning.
regua.titulo: The whole day on one ruler

pergunta.texto: Requests that come in through the app and the hotel link. The front desk answers each one: book it into a room, or decline and say why.

caixa.texto: The request due first sits at the top. The deadline only counts front desk hours: a request sent at night is due mid-morning.

resposta.texto: "Book Suite S1" saves the booking in that unit and notifies whoever asked. To pick a different one, use "Another room".

celular.texto: Open the phone and request the way a pet parent does — then watch the row arrive here, or the notification arrive there.

fita.texto: The whole day in one strip, at the top of every Hotel screen: each routine task is a tick at its time, arrivals and departures are marks, and the needle is now. Click it to open the routine.

chegam.texto: Time, face and room of everyone coming in today. The tag says whether the documents let them in; the button takes you to check-in, on the booking.

casa.texto: Who is staying, with what needs attention now: a call to make, medication, an update on hold. The row opens the stay.

saem.texto: Departure time and what is left before release: weighing, checking belongings, collecting the balance. Check-out is done on the stay.

pauta.texto: From most to least serious: incident with no call, arrival without documents, update on hold and overdue routine. Each row takes you where it gets solved.

bemEstar.texto: Who is stressed or still settling in, and today's doses in clock order, each with its status.

turno.texto: At the end of the shift, hand the house over: what is left pending, the incidents and a note. A serious incident with no call blocks the handover.

pergunta.texto: How each animal in the house is doing, wing by wing: who it is, whose it is, what the routine asks for now and how much of the day is done.

recortes.texto: All, the ones that need you and the ones leaving today. Search finds by the animal's or the owner's name.

corredores.texto: The list follows the physical order of the house, like walking down the wing. Each row starts with the room's sign.

linha.texto: Face, nights and departure, the owner with phone number, and in tags what blocks: incident with no call, update on hold, not weighed. The mark on the edge shows how serious. Click to open the stay.

foco.texto: The oldest overdue task, or the next one. Red when it is late, lavender when it is next.
